name: FluxCDN Security
author: fluxcdn

sections.description:
Vulnerability alerts, affected versions and available fixes for your WordPress plugins.

External service and privacy

This plugin uses FluxCDN Security and requires an account. When you connect or synchronize, the service receives your site address, WordPress and FluxCDN Security plugin versions, and installed plugin names, identifiers, versions and activation status to check for vulnerabilities. Requests use your FluxCDN Security API token. WordPress passwords, site content and user lists are not uploaded.

Review the service’s privacy policy and terms of use.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate FluxCDN Security. On Multisite, use Network Activate.
  2. Open FluxCDN Security and connect your account, or enter your API token.

HTTPS and OpenSSL are required. Your token must allow vulnerability checks.

If replacing wp-fluxcdn-security, deactivate it before activating this version. Keep its data-deletion setting off when uninstalling the previous version to preserve your connection and results.

Disconnect your site before uninstalling to stop its notifications. Disconnecting a site does not revoke a token shared with other sites.
